title: UK Businesses Without a Website — filters

sectors.title: Sectors
sectors.description: Which registers to draw from. care = CQC-regulated care locations (care homes, GPs, dentists, homecare); charity = Charity Commission register (England & Wales); school = DfE register of schools, academies, colleges and nurseries (England).

region.title: Region contains
region.description: Government Office Region, e.g. London, South East, North West (care and school sectors; charities carry no region).

local_authority.title: Local authority contains
local_authority.description: e.g. Leeds, Camden, Kent (care and school sectors; charities carry no local authority).

outward_code.title: Postcode area (outward code)
outward_code.description: First half of the postcode, e.g. LS1, SW1A, M — matched as a prefix-free substring, so 'LS' covers all Leeds outward codes.

charity_income_min.title: Minimum charity income (£)
charity_income_min.description: Charities only: skip those whose latest reported income is below this (many tiny charities have no site by choice). Default 25000.

care_service_types.title: Care service type contains
care_service_types.description: Care sector only: e.g. Care home, Nursing home, Homecare, Dentist, GP, Hospital.

school_phase.title: School phase contains
school_phase.description: School sector only: Primary, Secondary, Nursery, 16 plus, All-through.

max_results.title: Maximum results
max_results.description: Stop after this many records in total across the selected sectors (you are charged per result).
